Responsible for all Web API functions related to handling sorting codes in MANET.

item.name:
Returns a sorting code with the corresponding city and postal code.
The departure- and arrival code should be printed on the waybill and STES according to AGI.

If the API returns "N/A" the sorting code is missing. This is not an error. Print as is.
In case of time-out, print '---' for each code.
In case of other errors, print '???' for each code.
Caching responses for more than 24 hours is not recommended.

To use endpoint, invoke a HTTP POST request at 
'https://parcelservices-se.dbschenker.com/apipartner/SortingCode/v1/GetSortingCode'
